description: This file defines a function that generates column configurations for a data table displaying MCP server information, including fields such as server ID, name, URL, health status, access groups, timestamps, and action buttons for editing and deleting entries. It also imports various UI components and types to render interactive elements within the table.

methods.name: mcpServerColumns
methods.description: Generates an array of column definitions for displaying MCP server data, with custom renderers for each column, including buttons, icons, tooltips, and status indicators.
